It requires careful implementation of dynamical matrix construction, energy minimization, finite-difference volume derivatives, and numerical integration. The conceptual difficulty is moderate—not a novel derivation but a non-trivial assembly of standard components that demands genuine understanding of reciprocal space, crystal symmetry, and anharmonic physics.

All can be implemented in standard Python with scientific libraries, but managing the multi-step workflow, data flow between stages, and ensuring correctness of each intermediate output constitutes a moderate engineering orchestration task.
